column1: # Hand-authored seed of the clinical-finding lexicon (provenance tag "seed"; written by the team, no text copied).
# Long format: concept_id <TAB> field <TAB> value. Fields:
#   lay                Korean lay expressions (구어체), "|"-separated; a trailing "~" marks a figurative form that is
#                      NOT dropped by the simile rule ("몸이 불덩이~ 같아요" still means fever)
#   re                 one flexible Korean regex per row (".{0,N}" gaps never cross a comma at runtime)
#   neg                expressions that assert the concept is ABSENT ("잘 먹어요" -> no anorexia), "|"-separated
#   negre              one regex per row asserting absence
#   parents            parent concept ids, "|"-separated (present child => present parent; absent GRP => absent child)
#   flags              fig (all forms figurative-ok), group (downward absent inference), cue (emit only with an
# Matching is space-insensitive (spaces inside a form are optional), lower-cased, NFKC-normalised.
# Forms of 2 compact characters must start a word; forms of 3+ characters may sit inside a word.
